title: Note from Director Gortash

sources.title: Devil's Fee
markers: or finding the {{SmRarityItem|Note from Director Gortash}}

summary: A clue to Helsik’s services that can move the quest marker to the Devil’s Fee and unlock her Curated Selection.

fields.Quest use: Finding this note reveals Helsik as a diabolist. Bring up the clue in conversation with Helsik to unlock her Curated Selection and discuss passage to the House of Hope.
fields.Acquisition: DC 10 Perception reveals the loose floorboard by Helsik’s bed upstairs at the Devil’s Fee, X −28, Y 18.

changes: Added native BG3 quest or puzzle use verified against pinned item and location revisions.
